Twists Appointments Near Oakland, CA

What are twists?

Twists are a method for twisting hair into various styles.

Why book twists with StyleSeat?

Not only is StyleSeat the go-to place for all your beauty and grooming needs — we pride ourselves on inclusivity. We support all the members of our community and strive to connect you with service spaces where you can truly feel comfortable.

At StyleSeat, you can find spaces where you feel most connected — Black-owned, women-owned, queer-owned, LGBTQ-friendly — to name a few, and get serviced by beauty and grooming professionals who will help you look your best and feel more confident by the end of your appointment.

Our StyleSeat professionals feature photos of their work from previous twists appointments and list prices of their other services.

Many offer same-day, last minute, and walk-in appointments and easy payment options, including Touchless Payments and Klarna to split your payments into four interest-free installments. Are you trying to book for a special occasion, such as a wedding, graduation, or bridal shower? Our professionals can help.

StyleSeat makes finding your new beauty BFF a breeze.
